name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Ford goes with Tungsten; Otis goes with $57k; Graphene goes with $27k.
If Diesel does not go with Copper, then both Ford does not go with $37k and $47k goes with Copper.
Either Bell goes with Titanium or $57k goes with Ford.
Titanium, $27k, and $47k go with Bell, Ford, and Otis, in some order.
Graphene does not go with $37k if and only if all of Graphene goes with Diesel, Titanium goes with Bell, and Ford goes with Tungsten.

hints.text: Suppose Diesel went with $27k — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Diesel goes with $27k.
$27k goes with Diesel, so Bell can't go with $27k.
$27k goes with Diesel, so Ford can't go with $27k.
$27k goes with Diesel, so Otis can't go with $27k.
…but now the clue “Titanium, $27k, and $47k go with Bell, Ford, and Otis, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Diesel does not go with $27k.
